description_html: This fabulous 7th floor apartment forms part of the desirable Grade II listed Barbican estate, - one of the finest achievements of the architects Chamberlain, Powell & Bon. Located within the Barbican complex is the Barbican Arts Centre, including a concert hall, theatres, art gallery, cinemas and restaurants. The contemporary and spacious apartment retains some of the beautiful original features, including the original windows. The open-plan reception boasts French doors leading to a private balcony, offering stunning views of the London skyline, including St Pauls Cathedral. The state-of-the-art kitchen has all mod cons as well as a breakfast bar. Furthermore there is a modern bathroom, separate WC and a good-size bedroom leading to a second balcony overlooking the lush Residents gardens. Close to Smithfield Market, and Barbican and Moorgate Tube Stations.
